response.overview: Under the Orange Moon is a short film about 2 Moon entities extrapolated from 2 existing cultural myths - Chang’e the Moon God of the Chinese legends, as well as Rona from Māori legends.  Played by Nikita 雅涵 Tu-Bryant (Taiwanese) and Arahi Whaanga (Ngāti Rongomawahine, Ngāti Kahungungu).  This short was written and directed by Nikita 雅涵 Tu-Bryant and Chye-Ling Huang (Proudly Asian Theatre AKLD) with original score written by Tu-Bryant’s band KITA.
response.title: Under the Orange Moon
